apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Physical iPhone test: motion blocks gone and movement smooth with Metal 4 and active MetalFX in HEVC 10-bit 4:4:4 HDR. Metal 4 renders/upscales into two reusable private textures, then an event-gated standard Metal queue copies/presents them. Source and displayed cadence approximately 50 FPS; 120 FPS and iPad verification pending. Release build, 334 automated tests and 167 Mac GPU checks pass. Prior input/navigation fixes retained; frame generation remains removed. Unsigned build for installer signing.
